title: My AI-based weapon crafting system be like:
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
I’m Building an experimental RPG where players can create world content with their own words.

The world reacts to text prompts and evolves based on player decisions - I’m still exploring how far this can go.

Players can also create weapons with different stats through prompts and boost them with a matching character. 

What do you think of this? Could this be fun? 

Here’s the Steam page if you want to check it out: https://theflairgame.com/on-steam?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=weaponmeme&utm_content=aigamedev
(A wishlist would genuinely help a lot, if you like the idea <3)

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: I have Never played scribblenauts but from the Videos I watched it looked different from my Game although it also uses AI as a Feature. My Game is in an Open world Setting similar to gta online and how Players Interact with the world is also much different from what I have seen in scribblenauts

replies.author: Quind1
replies.body: We could use a modern version of Sccriblenauts, anyway. Will be watching your progress. Good luck.
